Canvas UI Grid — vanilla WebGL component

Source: https://canvasui.dev/r/grid-vanilla.json
Documentation: https://canvasui.dev/docs/components/grid
Retrieved 2026-10-04. Author: David Haz / Canvas UI.

Original TypeScript is preserved in GridVanilla.ts. grid.js was transpiled with
Node.js module.stripTypeScriptTypes, with no functional changes or dependencies.
The component is used as a decorative GPU overlay in the server summary.
The ordinary HTML interface remains fully functional without WebGL and when
reduced motion is preferred.
